title: 24/7 Managed Security Monitoring
shortDescription: Continuously monitor your digital environment for emerging threats and anomalies.
fullDescription: Round-the-clock Security Operations Center (SOC) vigilantly supervising hybrid environments worldwide. Combining high-velocity behavioral machine learning with seasoned human tier-3 threat analysts, SPECTRE DEFEND ensures 24/7/365 vigilance with rapid containment playbooks.
seoTitle: 24/7 Managed SOC & Autonomous Security Monitoring | SPECTRE DEFEND
seoDescription: Continuous 24/7 cyber surveillance and immediate incident response triage backed by elite threat hunting specialists.
whatIs: SPECTRE DEFEND 24/7 Managed Security Monitoring is a turnkey managed detection and response (MDR) service delivering continuous surveillance, threat hunting, and instant incident triage through our sovereign Security Operations Centers.
howItWorks:
1. Multi-Source Ingestion: Log streams, network netflow, identity events, and endpoint signals flow into our high-speed analytics lake.
2. Threat Correlation & Suppression: False positives are filtered using custom machine-learning correlation models.
3. Human Tier-3 Threat Hunting: Experienced SOC analysts actively hunt for stealth anomalies and unauthorized activities.
4. Rapid Coordinated Containment: When a true incident is verified, our team acts immediately according to tailored response runbooks.
whyItMatters: Adversaries rarely attack during standard business hours; weekend and holiday incursions are frequent. A 24/7/365 SOC ensures that intrusions are detected and contained with immediate priority, preventing protracted dwell time.
whoItIsFor: Mid-market to enterprise organizations that need continuous SOC monitoring capabilities without the overhead of building and staffing an internal 24/7 operations center.
deliverables: Rapid 15-Minute Critical Incident Notification SLA Target
Monthly Security Posture & Trend Analysis Reports

faqs.question: What is the response time when a critical incident occurs?
faqs.answer: SPECTRE DEFEND targets a rapid 15-minute SLA for critical severity incident triage and immediate containment initiation.

faqs.question: Can SPECTRE DEFEND ingest data from our existing SIEM or cloud logs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support pre-built connectors for Splunk, Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel, AWS CloudWatch, Google Chronicle, and Snowflake.
